panel.html: Device roles and the fixed layout are set on Topology Settings.

panel.title: CDP topology. Switches and APs (wifi icon) by health: green OK, yellow warning, red critical, dark grey no data. Click a switch for Switch Details, an AP for Wireless Overview

search.query: | `mdt_cdp(*)` | where NOT match(interface, "(?i)^(mgmt|e0m)") AND NOT match(coalesce(remote_interface, ""), "(?i)^(mgmt|e0m)") | eval from=node, to=neighbour | append [| mstats latest(_value) WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name=mdt_wl_info_ap_name BY ap_name cdp_cache_data_cdp_cache_device_id | eval from=ap_name, to=replace(cdp_cache_data_cdp_cache_device_id, "\..*$", ""), interface="uplink" | fields from to interface] | where from!=to | eval node1=if(from<to, from, to), node2=if(from<to, to, from) | stats dc(interface) as reported_links by node1 node2 from | stats max(reported_links) as links by node1 node2 | eval from=node1, to=node2, linkwidth=min(2*links, 10) | appendpipe [| eval node=mvappend(from, to) | stats count by node | eval color="#7b8794" | rename node as from | fields from color] | append [| `mdt_switch_health` | eval color=case(health=="Critical", "#dc4e41", health=="Warning", "#f8be34", health=="OK", "#53a051", true(), "#3c444d") | rename node as from | fields from color] | append [| `mdt_ap_health` | eval color=case(health=="Critical", "#dc4e41", health=="Warning", "#f8be34", health=="OK", "#53a051", true(), "#3c444d"), type="wifi" | rename ap as from | fields from color type] | appendpipe [| `mdt_topology_positions`] | eventstats max(x) as x max(y) as y max(value) as value by from | table from to linkwidth color type x y value

panel.title: Switch health, last 15 minutes. Warning from 70 % (CPU, memory, busiest port) or above 5 errors/min, critical from 90 % or 100 errors/min. Click for Switch Details

search.query: | `mdt_switch_health` | eval order=case(health=="Critical", 0, health=="Warning", 1, health=="No data", 2, true(), 3) | sort order node | rename node as Switch, health as Health, cpu as "CPU %", mem as "Memory %", util as "Busiest port %", errors as "Errors/min (busiest port)" | table Switch Health "CPU %" "Memory %" "Busiest port %" "Errors/min (busiest port)"

panel.title: Wireless clients, last 15 minutes, all WLCs. Click for Wireless Overview

search.query: | mstats latest(mdt_wl_ap_stats_num_assoc_clients) as c WHERE index=cisco_metrics span=1m BY extracted_source ssid_counters_wtp_mac ssid_counters_slot_id ssid_counters_wlan_id | where _time + 60 <= now() | stats sum(c) as c by _time | stats latest(c) as clients
| `mdt_ap_health` | stats count as total count(eval(state=="joined")) as joined | eval aps=joined." / ".total | fields aps

panel.title: WLC CPU %, highest WLC. Warning from 70, critical from 90

search.query: | mstats latest(mdt_xe_cpu_stats_one_minute) as cpu WHERE index=cisco_metrics [| mcatalog values(extracted_source) as extracted_source WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name=mdt_wl_info_ap_ip_addr | mvexpand extracted_source] BY extracted_source | stats max(cpu) as cpu | eval cpu=round(cpu, 0)

panel.title: WLC memory %, highest WLC. Warning from 70, critical from 90

search.query: | mstats latest(mdt_xe_mem_stats_used_memory) as used latest(mdt_xe_mem_stats_total_memory) as total WHERE index=cisco_metrics [| mcatalog values(extracted_source) as extracted_source WHERE index=cisco_metrics metric_name=mdt_wl_info_ap_ip_addr | mvexpand extracted_source] BY extracted_source memory_statistic_name | stats sum(used) as used sum(total) as total by extracted_source | eval mem=used / total * 100 | stats max(mem) as mem | eval mem=round(mem, 1)

panel.title: AP health, last 15 minutes. Channel busy % (rx + tx + noise, worst radio) warns from 50 and is critical from 75; interference warns from 25 and is critical from 50; an AP not joined or an enabled radio down is critical. Click for Wireless Overview

search.query: | `mdt_ap_health` | eval order=case(health=="Critical", 0, health=="Warning", 1, health=="No data", 2, true(), 3) | sort order ap | eval busy=if(isnotnull(busy), busy." % (".busy_band.")", null()) | rename wlc as WLC, ap as AP, health as Health, state as State, clients as Clients, busy as "Channel busy (worst radio)", inter as "Interference % (worst radio)", radios_down as "Radios down" | table AP Health State Clients "Channel busy (worst radio)" "Interference % (worst radio)" "Radios down" WLC
